final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rented_films FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_shares AS (SELECT rating, rented_films, rented_films * 1.0 / SUM(rented_films) OVER () AS share FROM rating_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM rating_shares) SELECT SUM(rs.rented_films) AS combined_rented_films, AVG(rs.share) AS average_share, AVG(rs.share - a.share) AS average_share_above_all_ratings FROM rating_shares AS rs CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE rs.share > a.share
